ITEM 1 | Long thin green bean-like pod, bright green with slight sheen, straight and about 12 cm long, lying at upper left edge of plate, firm and intact | 8
ITEM 2 | Fried fish fillet piece, golden-brown breaded/crisp outer crust with darker grey-brown flesh visible at edge, flaky light pinkish-white interior with blue-grey skin tinge, approx 9 x 6 cm footprint, about 2 cm thick, sitting on left-center of plate, flakes apart slightly | 120
ITEM 3 | Crumbled toasted nut or seed topping, pale tan to golden pieces about 0.5 to 1 cm, scattered dry and crunchy over the fish and rice, with some brown bits and small red flecks | 15
ITEM 4 | Stir-fried green leafy vegetable, dark green to bright green leaves with pale stem pieces, slightly glossy and wilted, soft and moist, piled in center-right of plate, about 8 x 6 cm and 3 cm high | 60
ITEM 5 | Brown rice mixed with small diced golden-brown and pink-tinged pieces, grainy, loose and separate grains, matte surface, mounded on right side of plate, about 9 x 7 cm and 2.5 cm high | 150
ITEM 6 | Small sliced green onion or scallion pieces and green herb strands, bright green, scattered among fish and rice, thin and limp | 5
